title: code.post-pr-review input
description: The orchestrated step envelope as code.post-pr-review sees it. This is a self-round target: `code.orchestrate-review` rebinds its own session for one turn, so the envelope is the controller's, with `boundAction` and `boundNote` set. `boundNote` is the approved payload — which comments to post and the exact body for each.

prUrl.description: The PR under review, when the step was created from a url rather than a watched PR.

artifacts.description: `findings` holds the review round's full findings; `postedReview` records what an earlier round already posted.

boundAction.description: Set to this action on the turn it runs.

boundNote.description: The approved comment set, verbatim: one entry per comment with file path, line, and the exact body to post. This is the text the user read at the gate.

gateApproved.description: True once the user approved the daemon's forced gate on this external write.

pr.description: Live PR facts kept by the watcher.
